Their criterion counts were Render 1, Constraints 1, Functional 64, Polish 7, Visual 6. Render prompt:14, Constraints prompt:15, Functional prompt:19, Polish prompt:21 and Visual prompt:33 consistently exclude sign-in/account requirements; there are no account credentials to mismatch.

Screens/entities agree: environment/instructions/ui.md:3-9 and overview.md:3-9 define editor/preview/console, examples, shared saved records, New/Save, title/filename, Run/Stop/Auto-run/Clear and both themes. tests/app_context.md:12 names those surfaces. Functional prompt S01/S19/S21-S24/S34 uses those same entities; its saved records contain title, filename, exact source, identity and revision, matching behaviour.md:25-29. Polish prompt:43-49 tours the same requested controls; its judge.toml:23 permits stacked/tabbed/drawer mobile presentations. Visual prompt:35-37 consistently assesses the editor, preview surround, console and saved-snippets surface, with both themes and flexible library placement. No sibling product, account list, foreign screen or unrelated entity shape occurs in the operative criteria.

Execution/deliverable agree: behaviour.md:5-15 and security.md:3-9 define isolated JS/HTML, fresh CSS copying, five-second shared callback budget, later interactivity, rollback, source error lines and separate app/snippet network policies. tests/app_context.md:18-20 and Functional prompt:13-17 and S02-S13/S36 use those same promises. integration.md:5-11 requires the finished local app at /app, localhost:3000, /api/health, durable saved state and restart. All composed prompts target localhost:3000; Constraints judge.toml:23 uses the documented /api/health; Functional prompt:23 and S22 use the one supplied restart tool and saved fields. tests/test.sh:195-200 injects the reviewed app_context into every dimension.

Adversarial source walkthroughs (not runtime measurements): a conforming app with no sign-in, a server-rendered library drawer, different labels/API shapes, an optional language indicator, a hidden pending preview and proactive stale-save prevention is expressly accommodated by Functional prompt:5,11,17,19,21,141,423-426; Polish prompt:43-47; and Visual prompt:37. No stale authentication, JSON-only endpoint, mandatory separate language selector, fixed layout or mandatory visible candidate requirement would falsely fail that alternative. A broken static sample/localStorage-only library cannot use the same flexibility to pass the prerequisites: Render judge.toml:25 requires a newly authored marker in actual preview and console; Constraints judge.toml:25-29 requires a new UI save and matching identity/fields from an independent clean context. A fake stale-save safeguard that discards dirty fields is excluded by Functional prompt:421-425. These witnesses revealed no false-pass/false-fail caused by inaccurate app description.

Two broad evidence-vocabulary phrases were checked rather than promoted to heuristic failures: Functional prompt:7 permits "imported/exported user files" as product data, and Constraints prompt:9-10 permits file contents from a stated probe. Neither instructs the judge to demand import/export or filesystem access, and no criterion or scenario adds those absent features. Functional prompt:7 also forbids guessed routes/hidden enumeration; the operative tasks remain entered snippet text and saved records. These generic evidence allowances do not establish a sibling-app residue defect.

No relevant inconsistency found for row 48. Full configured judge timing, Oracle and target-model results remain unmeasured as stated in raw-evidence-index.json; this source-only Pass makes no runtime, score or whole-QC clearance claim.
